latest.title: Cost-Effective PII Protection in Amazon S3: Prevent, Discover with Macie, and Remediate Automatically
latest.description: Sensitive data scanning at scale doesn't have to break your budget. This post walks through two complementary workflows for protecting PII in Amazon S3 — masking data in the ingestion path with Amazon Comprehend and AWS Glue before it lands, and discovering PII at rest with Amazon Macie's sampled automated discovery, then remediating findings automatically through EventBridge and Step Functions. Includes a worked cost model for a 25–50 TB estate and a phased rollout plan.

latest.title: How I Built the re:Invent Community Planner in One Night with AI
latest.description: I run a WhatsApp group for Brazilians going to re:Invent for the first time. Same questions every edition. Answers trapped in 23 voice messages. I consolidated everything into a real app: Vue.js, PWA, 3 languages, 14 hotels with booking links, budget calculator, interactive checklist, and 18 community tips extracted from voice messages. Built in one night using Kiro CLI as copilot, with SPEC and DESIGN before any code. 18 commits, 40s deploys, open source and ready for contributions.

latest.title: When RDS Storage Disappears and It Isn't Your Data
latest.description: A RDS PostgreSQL instance ran out of free space and started rejecting writes. I spent hours chasing table growth, temp spill, and WAL before finding the actual problem - which wasn’t data at all. This is a write-up of how to investigate runaway storage on RDS PostgreSQL, and how to avoid the wrong turns I took.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
